title: orchis cartaliniae
intro: Orchis cartaliniae, commonly known as the Wild Cat's Tongue, is a type of orchid plant that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Orchis cartaliniae include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its healing properties. The bioactive constituents of Orchis cartaliniae include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
